• Single guesser: only one player of the team, chosen beforehand, may try to guess the words.
• Double time: the time on the hourglass is doubled for this turn.
• Statue of salt: the clue giver must stay perfectly still (like a statue) while talking and gesturing.
• Everyone plays: the opposing team can also try to guess the word; whoever gets it first scores the point.
• Classic Taboo: no special rule; play by the normal Taboo rules.
